normalize_plausibilities: normalize unnormalized plausibility samples into categorical distributions along the last dimension
compute_rankk_certainties: compute rank-k certainties by counting frequencies of rank-k label occurrences across plausibility samples
map_across_plausibilities: apply a metric function across all plausibility samples per example using jax.vmap
bootstrap_aggregated_rankings: compute aggregated ranking samples from bootstrapped reader committees over multiple trials
majority_vote_argmax: compute the majority-voted top-1 label across all plausibilities per example
